name: codex-daydream
description: Turn recent Codex work into a privacy-preserving cartoon-poster concept and image-generation prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Make a private cartoon poster from today's work.
interface.longDescription: Read a bounded, locally sanitized slice of today's Codex tasks, turn the work into playful visual metaphors, and produce a copy-ready prompt for an image model without exposing project names, code, paths, people, credentials, or exact operational details.
interface.defaultPrompt: 把我从上次总结以来的 Codex 工作变成一张保护隐私的卡通海报提示词。
